name: @happyvertical/files
description: File system interface with local and remote provider support, rate-limited fetch, and caching
purpose: Unified API for local and remote file systems

functions.name: addRateLimit
functions.signature: (domain: string, limit: number, interval: number) => Promise<void>

architecture.notes: LocalFilesystemProvider is default; S3, WebDAV, Google Drive planned

patterns.name: Rate Limiting
patterns.usage: addRateLimit(domain, limit, interval) before fetch operations

pitfalls: Always use path.join() for cross-platform paths
Use streams for large files to avoid memory issues
Clean up temporary files in finally blocks
Rate limits are per-domain; configure before fetch calls
